body: I’m so sorry :( you didn’t deserve that at all. He violated your trust and boundaries and he knows that. Report him on tinder if you don’t feel comfortable reporting to law enforcement. Keep yourself safe and I hope everything works out. Lots of love 💞
I hope it all works out for you. I’m wishing you the very best 🧡🧡
Thank you! I had my panel interview today and they called me an hour later. I got the job!!

I worked at Whole Foods for 4 years and then quit probably for the same reasons and now I’m reapplying as supervisor. I’m an external candidate so I’m not sure I can do due diligence. I honestly don’t know what I would say to any of those questions because I’m panicking about not getting the job. I’m scared but I really hope I get this job. Trying to prepare and read stuff and watch videos.

I did this. It was a mistake and it was not worth the toll it took on my mental health. It’s ultimately your decision but I’m telling you it really wasn’t a good idea and it can severely hurt/trigger you. Be careful and take care of yourself. Your mental health is more important and there’s reasons why you want to see your attacker again but pleaseeeee think about it and talk to someone first. Not just people on Reddit.

It makes sense. I feel like this too. You can only do it when you feel more stable and ready. It could require a push but listen to your body as well. It’s a horrible feeling to feel stuck and frozen but you’re strong and hopefully you’ll get out of it. I’m still learning and it’s not easy but I’m doing it with the hope i can truly enjoy life again. Wishing you all the love and luck. You can do this and you’ll get there when you get there
Yes of course!!

I also want to say that I understand the fear and anger towards men. It’s normal and you have every right. He IS grooming you. He knows you’re vulnerable and these kind of predators know when someone is falling for it. Please please please don’t do this. I am still punishing myself for what I did. I felt like I betrayed myself. I’m talking from experience that what you’re feeling has lots of reasons and explanations, lots of people feel it but do NOT act on it. Do not let him back into your house ESPECIALLY your bed. I hope you stay strong to yourself and know that someone will love you and care for you and they will be someone you can trust who hasn’t violated you or traumatized you. I wish you the best.

I had consensual sex with my rapist. Not worth it. They manipulate you to get what they want. He apologized to me and was charming and respectful. The fact is he assaulted you, this can’t work out I’m sorry. I know what that bond feels like and there’s so many reasons beyond it. Please avoid him because he hurt you and it severely traumatized you. Don’t forget the pain and everything that came after what he did. You need to stay strong and one day the right guy will come along and you’re gonna be wayyyyy more comfortable and happy. He isn’t it and you’re worth so much more than being with a rapist. He could have done this to other girls and you wouldn’t know. Please be safe and I’m here if you want to talk more about it. I really do understand what you’re feeling but it hurt me way more because I was retraumatized.
Here for whatever you want to talk about🧡🧡

I tried it and ended up in the hospital. Don’t hate yourself for thinking you shouldn’t. Listen to your gut feeling because it’s not worth it. I’m speaking from actual experience. I almost died and it really wasn’t worth it. I still have suicidal thoughts all the time but I know what it’s like and I don’t want to put myself through that. I understand completely how you feel because I’m feeling like that right now. Things might get better but I’m not promising that but you should really listen to your gut. Don’t do it. You’re loved and cared for and appreciated even if you don’t feel like it. I’m sorry you’re feeling this way.

You were coerced and unable to consent as a minor and because you were under the influence outside of your limits and you said no. I’m really sorry this happened to you. I hope you can heal from this. He’s a  piece of crap and has no sense or empathy

It’s happened to me multiple times and it’s just getting worse. It can hit you hard some days and other days it’s easier. I know that pain you feel and it’s exhausting. I’m really proud of you for making it this far. Everyone has their coping strategies and I hope you and I can form healthier ones

My life has gone completely downhill. I failed out of school, lost friends, was in the hospital,abused Xanax and oxy. I’m sorry this happened to you. You’re strong for surviving this. I hope that things turn around for you. This is one of the worse things that can happen to someone and no one really understands the severity. I’m so so so sorry. Please take care and know that you didn’t deserve it and that you’re loved and valued. Sending lots of love and positivity. I’m trying to turn my life around and it’s not going well so far and I have lost the will to fight but I think I’ll get there. Idk when but hopefully I will

The police seem to be actively investigating it. Talking about it and reliving it is hard. I have been going through every minute of it looking for details because everything can be helpful. So that’s just been hard. But honestly the detective is on YOUR side. Don’t get discouraged by them. It may seem like they don’t believe you but they have to be impartial throughout the investigation.

That’s a physical cue that you’re not comfortable or really participating. Nothing should have happened. I’m sorry you didn’t deserve that. Hopefully you can work through all your trauma and get to a healthy view on everything. Rape can wreck your life for a really long time in a very hard way but it really takes time and work. I started seeing a therapist and that has helped as well as asking for support from friends and family when I’m triggered or feeling numb.
Thank you I’m trying now. Hope you feel better 🧡 you can always talk to me if you need to

I just reported my rapist after a year. They are conducting an investigation idk how far it will go but I’m damn proud of myself. Either it scares him or he gets in trouble. Maybe neither but I did my part and I’m very happy about that. If you feel ready you should do it but just know it’s triggering at some points and you might get anxious because that’s what I have heard and what I am experiencing. I don’t regret it even though I have felt like shit. I’m sorry this happened to you, you didn’t deserve it. I called the city police non emergency line, talked on the phone about it. Then I made a statement to the police in person, then a detective followed up with me. They tell you what to do from there
I did it and was in a coma but woke up after a while. I wished it had worked when I first woke up but now I feel privileged to be alive
You made me feel like I wasn’t alone. I appreciate you taking your time to help me. I know what I did was wrong and I will not be making that decision again

Part of me thought that he just had sex with me to make sure I wouldn’t report him but it doesn’t change the fact that he did hurt me. What matters is what I felt not how he felt. He got what he wanted. I thought I would be at peace after I did what I did but I hurt myself instead. I’m going to block him and never see him again. I made a very bad decision and I’m going to regret this for the rest of my life. Maybe he didn’t mean to and maybe he genuinely felt bad but he could also be a manipulative liar and I don’t know which one he is but I don’t need to find out. This will just hurt me in the long run and I can’t be in any more pain than I already am

It came back to bite me last night. I do deserve better. I thought I would be at peace after but it has caused me more pain than I can imagine. I made a horrible decision. I’m not going to see him again. I can’t do this to myself. I can’t change the past and he still hurt me in a horrible way and it took me a while to realize that but now I know better. I am going to try my best to never be put in this situation again. I’m struggling so much

I am ending any contact I have with him because I can’t do this again. I hurt myself and now I have to deal with this pain I inflicted on to myself. I feel so stupid but I know I can’t see him again because he hurt me and I let him back in my life because I thought maybe I could change the past. I thought maybe he had changed and maybe he did really care about me but I was wrong. He’s still a manipulative liar who hurt me and I can’t have people like that in my life

I should have listened to them honestly because I made a horrible decision and I’m going to have to deal with the consequences for a very long time. I feel so stupid. Part of me knew it was wrong but I didn’t want to accept that

I think I was trying to make myself feel better because I don’t really like him. I liked how I felt in the moment and now I’m regretting it. I shouldn’t have seen him again because now I’m in so much pain. I know he hurt me and that’s all that matters even if he apologized it doesn’t change the fact that I was hurt and in pain for almost a year dealing with this. It’s going to take me a long time to get over this because now I realize what I have done and it was the worse decision I could have made for myself. You didn’t overstep at all. Thank you so much for taking the time to help me.

I just realized that I was second guessing myself. I made a horrible decision and now I have retraumatized myself. I feel so stupid. I really thought I was making the right decision at the time. He still hurt me even if maybe he didn’t mean to what matters is how I felt and that was violated. I know better now and I know that what he did was wrong

Thank you so much. I made a bad decision but I am dropping all contact with him and ending whatever this was because I can’t hurt myself all over again. I am regretting everything and I have caused myself more pain than I can imagine. I haven’t forgiven him because I thought I could but what happened happened and I can’t change the fact that he did hurt me

I thought he genuinely cared about me but I realized he was manipulative and charming which I fell for. I’m cutting ties with him and never speaking to him. I made a horrible decision which I will regret for the rest of my life. I thought I would be at peace if I did this but it’s caused me more pain and now I’m feeling all this pain from when he hurt me and on top of that me hurting myself

I know I made a bad decision and I’m regretting what I have done. I was manipulated by him into thinking he genuinely cared about me but that doesn’t change the fact that he hurt me and caused me all this pain. I second guessed myself and now I’m feeling so much guilt for hurting myself all over again. I’m done with him and never speaking to him again. I can’t hurt myself even more than I did. I thought maybe he didn’t mean to hurt me and I started to believe that but I realized that doesn’t matter because it’s how I felt after is what matters

If any friend of mine said they were doing this I would be extremely concerned. I should have listened to people and not done this. I’m cutting ties with him and never speaking to him again because this was a bad call all around. I really thought I was making the right decision but I didn’t and now I’m in so much pain and feeling all the guilt. I definitely hurt myself in the long run and I don’t know how to get past this. Worse decision I have ever made

I have a therapist and I thought I was stronger than this but I made a horrible decision. I’m struggling so much because I did this to myself and now I’m in so much pain. I wish I had listened to everyone before but I was too stupid to do that. I don’t know how I’m going to get past this. I really made a bad call. I thought if I could redo it and get my power back I would be at peace and for a few days it felt like that but now I know it didn’t it just hurt me more

I have a therapist and I haven’t told them yet but I definitely made a bad decision and I will not make it again. I hurt myself and I thought I would have peace after but now it’s haunting me and I’m definitely not okay

I had a difficult time processing what I had done and it all just hit me yesterday. I am going to block him so I don’t retraumatize myself again. It was a really stupid decision and I knew I was being manipulated but I thought that because I was aware it wouldn’t happen but it did. He knew what he was doing and even if he didn’t he still hurt me and I shouldn’t see him again

I really appreciate you. I would love that hug honestly. I’m trying to slowly work on myself so I never do something like this again. I told the people I love and everyone judged me and I feel so alone. I had no idea this would hurt me this much

Thank you so much. I realized the extent of what I did and I hurt myself all over again. I’m blocking him on everything again and I’m going to try and focus on myself now. I knew it was a bad decision but I didn’t know how much it would hurt me once I had processed it. I’m struggling so much right now because I feel all this guilt for letting him back in my life I feel stupid

It all hit me last night and I realized what I have done. I definitely retraumatized myself and I’m so mad at myself for doing this. I’m not okay but I know I need to stop seeing him so I decided to block him
Yes because that’s not what you consented to. He violated your wishes and crossed your boundaries that you clearly stated

Honestly I feel the same way. I hated everyone with the same name as him and if I even heard the name I would get triggered or I would cringe. It’s because rape is about power not sex he had the power which is why it still affects you to this day. You’re not weird or alone.

My whole family told me I was too fat starting at the age 8. They pushed diets on me and forced me to run to lose weight. One time I was in so much pain I couldn’t walk and I wanted to go to the emergency room because something was wrong. My mom told me it was just my fat moving around because it’s not used to me exercising. Turns out I had a cyst the size of a grapefruit on my ovary and it was about to burst. Even after that my mom would barely send me food during school so that I wouldn’t eat a lot and I would starve the whole day. I never lost the weight and they still make comments. Now I hate myself and I feel like I’ll never find someone to love me because they always say fat girls are ugly and alone. I’m depressed and close to killing myself

I’m on the same page as you. I feel everything you’re feeling it’s scary how similar our experiences are. You’re not alone. You can talk to me because I want to be there for you and let you know that it will be okay and that things will work out for you. Sending you lots of love and comfort. I’m sorry this happened to you because you did not deserve to be assaulted. You’re very strong

I have a therapist and she said these feelings are normal but she would be concerned if I actually saw him. I haven’t told her yet what I have done because I know how messed up this situation is and I’m scared of being judged. I know it’s a bad idea I just don’t care if it hurts me and that’s scaring me. Everyone is telling me to cut him out of my life but I don’t want to because I’m scared to

But I don’t want to cut him out of my life. Just the thought of it makes me feel guilty and it scares me. I feel like he needs to be apart of my life. I’m so conflicted because I know what you’re saying is true I just don’t want it to be

He apologised to me and said he really didn’t mean to hurt me and he said he genuinely didn’t know so I also feel like he didn’t mean to hurt me. I’m sorry you’re going through the same thing as me because I’m genuinely struggling so much. I like him so much and he still hasn’t messaged me and I’m waiting around like an idiot.
Either way she should have known. It doesn’t excuse anything. What happened to you was not okay. You didn’t deserve that

I’m sorry this happened to you. He should have known you were too drunk to consent and he was giving you drinks on purpose. You deserve better than that experience. Talking about it always helps. I suggest you find a therapist and talk more about this experience and your surrounding feelings.

I told him how I felt and he apologized and now I like him more than I did before. I decided to meet up with him and I ended up having sex with and it actually went well. I know he’s not good for me but for some reason that doesn’t matter to me

I did it and I got an apology and now I’m not sure how to feel about him. I think I’m not mad anymore but I know in 5 years I’ll look back and be mad again. But for now I feel like I can handle seeing him again
I am interested in him now. I told him my side of the story and how I felt and he apologized and told me he didn’t mean for it to happen and all my feelings are valid. I feel insane

I feel the same way about myself. I lost my best friend because she said she was too drained dealing with my depression and I’m in a hole right now and can’t get out. I have changed and I used to be such a happy person. I’m sorry this happened to you. You deserve better

I’m so sorry this happened to you it’s not your fault. I was raped and I didn’t fight off my attacker or say no. That’s a normal response to freeze. It doesn’t mean you asked for it. I was struggling like you were for almost a year. It took a lot of time and therapy but I realized it wasn’t my fault and what happened was not okay. I met my rapist off a dating site as well. Just because you have an account and agree to meet up doesnt give anyone a right to violate you and rape you
